title: Project Pulse
description: an progression based create style modpack
body:
# Project Pulse

Project Pulse is a light modpack designed to be played with friends, where you can setup complex factories, farms or town and explore exiting dungeons for new loot and research to expand your base.

# 
- ⚙️ **Automate** Build complex factories using new machines.
- 🚊 **Transport** Get to different places by using trains, planes, or cars.
- 🪙 **Economy** Get rich by selling to other players or spend all your money at someone else's shop.

# Notice
